description: This file implements filtering functions 'filter_exclude' and 'filter_include' for lists of strings, used within the 'functions' namespace, providing mechanisms to include or exclude list elements based on pattern matching.

methods.name: RunFilter
methods.description: Core function that filters a list of string values based on a pattern matching criterion, either including or excluding elements depending on the 'selection' parameter.

methods.name: RunFilterExclude
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls RunFilter with the exclude filter selection.

methods.name: RunFilterInclude
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls RunFilter with the include filter selection.
